dog.description_text:
Ed found himself homeless at just a baby, but we made a promise to give him the happy future he deserves. And from the moment he arrived, Ed made one thing very clear: he absolutely loves his people!

This sweet boy craves human affection. He'll seek out his humans, asking for pets, rubs, and all the attention he can get. He's young, playful, affectionate, and has so much love to give. Simply put, Ed is one of the sweetest little boys you'll meet!

Ed is looking for a family who can give him the time, attention, and socialization every young kitten needs. He wants a home where he can run, play, explore, and be his adorable little self. He could also do wonderfully with another playful cat or a friendly dog to keep him company.

Ed has so much love waiting to give. All he needs now is a family to share it with. Adopt today!
dog.name: Ed
